svg.title: cpp-linter: C/C++ pull requests that arrive already checked.
svg.desc: A loop of the four ways cpp-linter reports on a pull request: notes in the diff, one summary comment, suggestions you can commit, and fixes pushed by auto-fix.
svg.text: clang-format and clang-tidy, reported on the pull request.

g.text: File src/parser.cpp does not conform to Custom
Some files did not pass the configured checks!
clang-format -i runs on the files with style issues,
and the result is pushed to the pull request branch.
